title: Review artifacts in isolated reviewer context
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs Agentic Recipe `independent_review` with two isolated reviewers that omit producer reasoning, aggregate findings, and retain disagreement. Accepts inspiration requirement 10. Related: `fangore_insp_produce_critique_refine`. [^insp-r10][^insp-pa-03-review]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `independent_review` via `IndependentReviewTemplate` / `independent_review_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`IndependentReviewRecipeAdapter`).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `independent_review_template.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; expects review_count, omit_producer_reasoning, disagreement_retained.
